backlogged.summary: harness decide's backlog item (kind: decision) is added without a `summary` field and never gets `resolved_by` set (resolveItems only resolves ids listed in a later contract's `resolves` array). Since openItems/backlogSection (lib/eval.mjs:437-447) render `i.summary ?? ''`, every future eval prompt's '## Open backlog' section — and `harness status`'s open-item count — will permanently show a blank '- Bn [-] ' line for each decision, for the life of the project. Confirmed via `openItems({items:[{id:'B1',kind:'decision',...}]})` returning the item with no summary and no way to close it.

harness note [F<n>] does not validate that F<n> exists in features.json (unlike harness decide, which does), so a typo'd feature id is recorded silently. The contract only says the feature is optional, not that it must be known, so this is a minor asymmetry rather than a spec violation.
